comment: DISCOVERY SCOUT = the automated front of the Research Bee. Every 6h it scans Base + Robinhood Chain new and trending pools, filters them, and queues CANDIDATES for research. It never scores, never publishes a research.verdict and can never cause a trade: a token reaches the Trader Bee only after research says PASS. Every number here is a beekeeper setting.

quote_assets.comment: The pool's OTHER side is the candidate. Base: WETH, USDC, cbBTC, DAI, USDT. Robinhood: USDG. Unknown quote assets are handled by picking the side that is not in this list.
